summary: Iteration 8 — validated the four P0 upgrades end-to-end. (1) MongoDB restart survival: set hospital scenario to 'Emergency surge', waited 32s past the tick-15 checkpoint, ran `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, then re-hit GET /api/twins/hospital — scenario preserved and tick did NOT regress (pre=15+, post>=pre). Also verified after a second restart, all 5 non-traffic domains still had tick>=15. Mongo db.twin_state confirmed to contain docs for hospital/building/industrial/energy/water. (2) WebSocket domain envelope: connecting to /api/ws/traffic delivers initial 'snapshot' plus 'domain_snapshot' messages within 5s and all 5 domains broadcast inside a single 12s window with shape {domain,state,kpis,tick,scenario,running}. (3) Backend regression: 28/28 in /app/tests/test_twins_domains.py PASS (health, twins/*, domains, data-sources, traffic public endpoints, auth, users/audit RBAC). (4) Frontend: Playwright verified /domains/{hospital,building,industrial,energy,water} each renders sidebar-mode-{d}, domain-3d-{d} with a real <canvas>, domain-ws-status transitions to CONNECTED within ~3s, KPI grid populates (4-5 metrics per domain), TRAFFIC_NAV (nav-twin) is absent on non-traffic pages and domain nav (nav-d-twin, etc.) is present, chip .on class follows URL. Chain traffic→hospital→building→industrial→energy→water→traffic transitions cleanly with sidebar mode and scene testid flipping every hop. Deep-link /domains/energy renders sidebar-mode-energy and chip-on on first paint. Scenario mutation via UI (domain-scenario-emergency on hospital) propagated to the WS status header (tick 305→308, scenario 'Normal operations'→'Emergency surge') and 6 domain-alert-* rows appeared within 6s without a manual reload.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 813 lines — still under the 700-line soft cap after twins split, but simulation_loop() is >90 lines mixing vehicle physics, congestion, convoy, twin ticks, persistence and broadcast. Consider splitting into `_tick_traffic()` / `_tick_domains()` / `_broadcast_all()` helpers for testability.

_persist_domain_state() swallows exceptions with logger.debug — a Mongo outage would silently degrade to in-memory only. Elevate to warning and expose via /api/system/health so operators see the last successful checkpoint timestamp.

DomainTwin.jsx opens a fresh WebSocket per domain mount and closes on unmount — chain-nav across 6 domains opens/closes 6 sockets. Consider hoisting the socket into DomainContext or a shared hook (WsProvider) so a single connection multiplexes.
twins.py hospital events still slice to 40 after unbounded append per tick (documented last iter); low priority.

Sidebar.jsx uses NavLink `end` prop conditionally — works, but the special-case string comparison `to === /domains/${activeDomain}` is fragile if TWIN nav path scheme changes; consider making each nav entry declare its own `end` flag.

success_rate.backend: 100% (32/32 across both suites, incl. 2 restart-survival + 2 WS envelope tests)
